enso.status: El Nino Advisory. Strong-to-very-strong El Nino likely through Jan-Mar 2027 (>79%); ~60% chance of a historic event (3-month RONI >= +2.5) in OND/NDJ.

ecmwf.source: Meteomatics ecmwf-mmsf (ECMWF seasonal) sea surface temperature over Nino 3.4, anchored to NOAA CPC OISST (https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/sstoi.indices)

start.fall: root-zone soil wetness Aug-Sep 2026 (NASA POWER, observed), z vs 1991-2020
start.wspr: precipitation Oct 2026 - May 2027, % of 1991-2020 normal (ERA5 + ECMWF seasonal forecast via Meteomatics, issued 2026-11-14)

method.target: Observed average yield by Statistics Canada Small Area Data Region (table 32-10-0002), region-years seeded >= 1000 ha, 1981-2025
method.weather: NASA POWER, cropland-weighted per region: growing-season mean daily high and root-zone soil wetness (anomalies vs 1991-2020, monthly data), heat degree-days above 30 C, longest dry spell, wettest 5 days and killing-frost days (daily data)
method.model: log yield = region level + technology trend (recency: province trend + shrunk regional deviation) + weather effect: 0.5 x conditions-based analogs (mean yield anomaly of the 80 most similar region-years in any region, by summer heat, soil wetness and location) + 0.5 x regression (crop-wide + shrunk provincial response, with heat and drought curvature)
method.climate_change: each past season's temperature is moved onto the target year's climate along the region's observed 1981-2026 warming trend, and its heat degree-days re-read at the threshold lowered by the same warming
method.starting_conditions: each past summer's soil moisture is moved onto this season's starting point: the observed fall root-zone wetness replaces the analog's own (per-province regression of summer soil moisture on it); a forecast of Oct-May precipitation only shifts the centre and keeps every analog's spread (its skill is unknown)
method.enso: past seasons weighted by closeness of their DJF and JJA RONI to the CPC forecast, kernel bandwidth and blend chosen by hindcast
method.confidence: mixture quantiles widened/narrowed symmetrically about the median so that central ranges match their coverage in forward-chaining hindcasts (2001-2025)
method.normal: median of the same model with every past season weighted equally (no ENSO information), in today's climate: what an average year would bring with today's farming and climate
caveats: Regional (Census Agricultural Region) yields: every ecodistrict in a region shows the same forecast.
A very strong El Nino has only ~4 analogs since 1981 (1983, 1992, 1998, 2016); 1992 also had the Pinatubo cooling.
No CO2 fertilisation, adaptation or variety change beyond the fitted technology trend.
Warming scenarios extrapolate a statistical model; temperatures beyond the observed range are clipped, so damage from unprecedented heat is understated.
Hindcasts used a simple statistical ENSO forecast; CPC's real forecasts are at least as good, so hindcast skill is a conservative guide.
Hail, frost, disease, harvest weather and prices are not modelled; they sit in the residual spread.
